# `nlink-lab shell`

## Reference

<!-- cli-ref:start (generated by `nlink-lab docs-gen`; do not edit) -->

```text
Open an interactive shell in a lab node

Usage: nlink-lab shell [OPTIONS] <NODE>

Arguments:
  <NODE>
          Node name

Options:
  -L, --lab <LAB>
          The lab. Default: `$NLINK_LAB`, then the one `nlink-lab use` selected, then the only running lab

      --shell <SHELL>
          Shell to use (default: /bin/sh)
          
          [default: /bin/sh]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

<!-- cli-ref:end -->
